observed_problem_or_opportunity: The current profile can deploy six simultaneous positions despite an account capacity of ten. The remaining uncertainty is not insufficient nominal risk; it is whether the routes possess compatible after-cost edge and how often their losses co-trigger.

main_risks_and_failure_modes: The stacked marginal-p99 stop wave is not a joint probability estimate and can understate correlated gap losses.
Stop gaps, order latency, mark outages, or thin visible depth can exceed the modeled 80-bps stop and marginal-p99 friction.
Ten positions is account capacity only; the current six-asset roster can hold at most six simultaneous positions under one-position-per-asset enforcement.
Sixty percent isolated margin is exposure at risk, not a precise liquidation-loss ceiling.
The first resolved HYPE stop is one observation and cannot validate the full friction distribution.
Sizing evidence does not establish profitability or trade frequency.
